description: Takes one of the person's own listings off agentPickup's marketplace, for example when they've sold it elsewhere or changed their mind: buyers can no longer find, offer on or buy it. Works on a draft, a listing waiting for a check, or a live one; an item someone is paying for or has bought can't be taken down (use cancel_purchase for that sale). Confirm with the person first. To put it back up later, open it with get_listing and they sign again in the card, or change it first with create_listing and its listing_id. Needs sign-in.

listing_id.description: The listing's id (lst_...), from my_listings or the listing card.

reason.description: Why it's coming down, if the person said: kept for agentPickup's records, never shown to buyers. Default other.

name: end_listing
title: Take a listing down
